articles.title: Altman won't go public for less than $1 trillion, so OpenAI's IPO may slip to 2027
articles.summary: Advisors are telling OpenAI to hold off on going public until next year. The triggers: volatile tech markets and SpaceX's weak stock performance after its record IPO. SoftBank, one of OpenAI's biggest backers, lost 13 percent in a single day. The article Altman won't go public for less than $1 trillion, so OpenAI's IPO may slip to 2027 appeared first on The Decoder.

articles.title: OpenAI Weighs IPO in 2027 | Bloomberg Tech 6/26/2026
articles.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down OpenAI's decision to potentially hold off on an IPO until next year - sending shares of SoftBank falling. Plus, global tech stocks drop after Apple hikes hardware price due to a memory crunch, and SpaceX's $25 billion bond sale is off to a rocky start. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: AI Cost Reality Check Hits Asia Tech Stocks as Apple Hikes Prices
articles.summary: Asian technology stocks slumped after Apple Inc. and Microsoft Corp. raised prices for their products, stoking concern that rising component costs will curb demand for devices and eventually slow the memory chip rally that has powered much of the AI trade. Bloomberg Tech Host Ed Ludlow discusses the move from Apple to raise prices as well as what's next for OpenAI as they mull a delay for the company's IPO. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Morgan Stanley, Goldman Shares Fall on Possible OpenAI IPO Delay
articles.summary: Shares of Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. fell on Friday after OpenAI is said to weigh holding off on an initial public offering until next year amid volatility in technology stocks.
articles.author: Georgie McKay

articles.title: OpenAI Weighs IPO in 2027 After Expected Anthropic Public Debut
articles.summary: OpenAI is considering an initial public offering as soon as in 2027, according to people familiar with the matter, a timeline that would potentially see it go public after its artificial intelligence rival Anthropic PBC.

articles.title: SoftBank Shares Tumble After Report of OpenAI’s IPO Delay
articles.summary: SoftBank Group Corp.’s stock fell as much as 13% on concerns that OpenAI may hold off on an initial public offering until next year and delay returns for its Japanese backer.
articles.author: Aya Wagatsuma

articles.title: OpenAI Leans Toward Waiting Until 2027 for IPO, NYT Says
articles.summary: OpenAI is leaning toward holding off on an initial public offering until 2027, the New York Times reported, citing three people involved in the company’s deliberations.

articles.title: Micron Soars After AI-Fueled Forecast Shatters Estimates | The Opening Trade 6/25/2026
articles.summary: Micron, the largest US maker of computer memory chips, surged in premarket trading after its quarterly sales forecast crushed Wall Street estimates, signaling that an AI-fueled growth run remains strong. Micron posted the results at a delicate moment for the AI industry. Shares of chipmakers and other technology companies had been hammered in recent days on fears that a spending boom was faltering. The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Guy Johnson and Tom Mackenzie. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Warren to Call for Antitrust Scrutiny of AI, Deal Review Revamp
articles.summary: Massachusetts Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren is planning to urge Congress to push for greater antitrust enforcement on emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and revamp merger law to make more information public.

articles.title: Micron Earnings Take on New Gravity With Market on Edge Over AI
articles.summary: Tuesday’s stock-market slide was what one Wall Street strategist called a “chip-wreck.” The semiconductor companies that have led this year’s stock-market advance with triple-digit percentage gains were suddenly hit with a wave of doubts about the sustainability of the AI-driven rally. Daniel Ives, Global Head of Technology as Wedbush Securities, discusses the broader tech landscape as investors remain jittery on high-flying tech stocks. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: SpaceX Sells $25 Billion of Bonds, Cuts Interest Costs
articles.summary: SpaceX sold $25 billion of investment-grade bonds on Tuesday, marking the final step to replace the costly debt that had helped finance Elon Musk’s acquisition of X, then known as Twitter, as well as the expensive loans and bonds issued by xAI to bridge its rapid cash drain. Bloomberg's Manuel Baigorri reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
